title: Annex to the Cash Pickup Tariff: Reactivation Lateness Charge
content:
A lateness charge is added to the fee for reactivating an expired Cash Pickup pickup when the reactivation comes well after the expiry.

**Days counted.** The calendar days from the day the pickup expired to the day of the reactivation. The expiry day is not counted.

**Charge.** The charge is worked out in one of three ways:

| Days since expiry | Lateness charge |
|---|---|
| more than 21 | accrues by the day: the days since expiry multiplied by 0.05 USD, rounded half up to the cent |
| from 8 up to 21 | a flat 0.50 USD, whatever the exact number of days |
| fewer than 8 | no lateness charge |

The lateness charge is added to the reactivation fee and becomes part of it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical pickup expired on 1 April)

| Reactivation on | Days since expiry | Lateness charge |
|---|---|---|
| 8 April | 7 | none |
| 9 April | 8 | 0.50 |
| 22 April | 21 | 0.50 |
| 23 April | 22 | 1.10 |
| 26 April | 25 | 1.25 |
| 1 May | 30 | 1.50 |

Above 21 days every day since expiry is charged, not only the days beyond 21.
